analysis:
Reviewed the base text of provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/ProviderLoop.swift (lines 1-1125) and the bounded head patch excerpt.

The head side changes only actor stored-state declarations:
- autopilotHistory becomes a labeled tuple with an added detail field (head 343-344).
- New Autopilot state is added (head 356-404): autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, autopilotHolds, autopilotDownloadSettingsOverride, autopilotDownloadStorage/At, and an autopilot download prefetch coordinator. Per its comment, that coordinator's verified builds join the Autopilot inventory rather than the advertised set.

These are declarations only; the visible lines contain no behavior. Init (base 801-898) is not shown as changed. It still filters autopilotInventory by a non-empty weightHash, CBv2 support and runtime eligibility. Keys, the attestation signer and hashing are unchanged.

No security regression is identifiable from these units. The behavior lives in companion files not supplied here (ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement, ProviderLoop+AutopilotDownload). Integration should verify the following:
- Builds downloaded by Autopilot that are later adopted (autopilotAdoptedModelIDs) and served must pass the same verified weight-hash and self-test gates. This covers failedSelfTestHashes, retiringModels and liveModelHashes in attestation responses (T-012, T-027, A-004).
- Models outside the advertised set must not be served or loaded without coordinator-visible hash registration.
- Holds must not block retirement of failed builds.
- The download path must respect the disk budget and reserve (T-016).
- The new detail string in autopilotHistory, if it is published in daemon state or heartbeats, must not leak sensitive data (T-058).

The patch excerpt is truncated, so the full head additions were not seen.
